subject: 🏃 Friday — Hip & Core B
html:
Today: Hip & Core B — your second lower-body session of Week 2. You did 2 rounds last time; aim for all 3 today.

I still need your knee status from Tuesday's run. That 5.79 mi at 8:13/mi avg (HR 148, max 177) is sitting in the log with a pending knee status. It blew past the Chassis Build guardrails — 5 mi cap, HR <140, and it replaced a Mobility Deep-Dive day. I flagged it yesterday. If the knee talked at all after that effort, I need to know before we plan the weekend. Please report back today.

Session plan: Full warm-up first — foam roll lower body (5 min), banded hip IR activator (8 reps each side), 90/90 PAILs/RAILs (2×10 sec each direction, each side), cossack squats (8 each side), fire hydrants (15 each side). Then 3 rounds of the main circuit. Finish with wall sits (45 sec × 3) and TKE on the right leg (3×15).

Recommended weights:

ExerciseLoadSets × Reps
Bulgarian split squat15 lb/hand3×10 each side (3-sec eccentric)
Single-leg RDL15 lb/hand3×10 each side
Side plank w/ hip abduction (PT)Bodyweight3×8 each side — top toe points to floor
Banded lateral walksLight band3×15 each direction
Bird dogBodyweight3×10 each side, 2-sec hold
Dead bug — banded pulldown (PT)Light band2–3×10 slow marches
Chin tuck + lifts (PT)Bodyweight2 reps each direction, 3-sec hold
Pallof press w/ rotationLight band3×12 each side
Front plank w/ shoulder tapBodyweight3×20 total

Focus cue: On the side plank with hip abduction, commit to pointing the top toe toward the floor. That internal rotation of the lifting leg is the PT's explicit cue — it targets the exact hip IR limitation we're rebuilding. Slow reps, both sides equal.

Context: Week 2 of 4 in Chassis Build, 14 days to PT follow-up on May 15. The split squat clearing at 15 lb with a green knee last week was a real positive signal. Keep building. Tomorrow is Upper Pull — different location, lighter day. Sunday is cycling 75 min easy or a 90-min hike.
